name: Sapling of Colfenor

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power, then put it into your hand.

notes: APPROXIMATION: no condition can ask whether the bound card ('that') is a creature card, so the life gain, the life loss and the move to hand run for whatever the top card is. A noncreature card has power and toughness 0, so the two life effects are correctly 0 for it; the deviation is that a noncreature card is also put into your hand instead of staying on top (see needs).

issues: IF IT'S A CREATURE CARD, you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power, then put it into your hand. — expected A noncreature top card stays on top of the library and no life changes. — scripted No condition is attached; the move to hand runs unconditionally (script notes admit it). Blind run confirms: Lightning Bolt ended in hand, library 20 vs 21, hand 1 vs 0. — CR 608.2a

REVEAL the top card of your library — expected the card becomes public information to all players — scripted {op:'look-top', who:'you'} — a private look; opponents never see it (game.ts emits action 'look', not a reveal). — CR 701.15 (reveal) vs 701.14 (look at)

gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power — expected the P/T of a card in the library — scripted {prop:'toughness'/'power', of:'that'} — works only via the printed-P/T fallback for a library card, and reads 0 for noncreature cards (which is why the life totals happen to come out right in that case). — CR 208.1

IF IT'S A CREATURE CARD, you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power, then put it into your hand. — expected A noncreature card stays on top of the library and no life changes. — scripted No condition on the bound card; the move to hand runs unconditionally (notes admit this). Blind scenario confirms: Lightning Bolt ends in hand, library 20 vs 21, hand 1 vs 0. — CR CR 608.2a

reveal the top card of your library — expected Reveal — the card becomes public information to every player. — scripted op 'look-top' (game.ts:1270) emits action:'look' with who:'you'; only the controller sees the card, so opponents get no information the printed card gives them. — CR CR 701.16 (reveal) vs 701.15 (look at)

you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power — expected The printed P/T of the revealed card. — scripted {prop:'toughness'/'power', of:'that'} — works because a library card falls back to printed P/T (and yields 0 for a noncreature), but the renderer calls it 'that permanent's toughness'; correct only incidentally. — CR CR 208.1
